name: request_user_input
description: Ask the user one to three concise, structured questions when their input is genuinely needed. The app renders these as interactive cards. Call this tool instead of writing a questionnaire in prose. After calling it, stop and wait for the user's next message; never guess their answers.

id.description: Stable short identifier using lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.

question.description: One clear sentence shown to the user.

type.description: Response control. Prefer single_choice when options are mutually exclusive.

options.description: Required for choice questions. Put the recommended option first and suffix its label with '(Recommended)'.

why.description: Optional concise explanation of how this answer changes the work.
